name: Outbreak
source:
A group of friends decided to go away on a vacation to a resort located far away from home, little did they know about the horrors that they will endure there. Will you survive?? Will your friends or loved one survive?

[From Patreon]
translation:
一群朋友决定去远离家乡的一个度假胜地度假，但他们不知道在那里将要忍受的恐怖。你会活下来吗？你的朋友或亲人能活下来吗？

[来自帕特伦]
